artworks.title: Scene from Ancient History
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 16th Century after Polidoro da Caravaggio
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink with gray wash
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures surrounding a central scene involving the presentation of a small statue. The figures are depicted with expressive gestures and draperies, exhibiting a classical style with a focus on narrative. In the scene, a bearded man with a staff stands opposite several other figures who hold out a small statue. To the right, there is a smaller figure positioned next to a decorated pedestal with ornate details, supporting another statue. The background contains silhouetted figures, adding depth to the composition. The artwork features fine line work and detailed shading, highlighting the characters and their interactions.

artworks.title: Two Figures Struggling before a King
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black  chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with figures. The sketch depicts a classical architectural setting with arches and columns, where several figures are shown in dynamic poses. Some figures appear to be raising their arms. One figure is wearing a crown. The drawing employs fine lines and washes of ink, giving it a sense of depth and shadow. The architectural elements suggest a grand and formal interior space. The figures are dressed in flowing garments, highlighted with subtle shading. The composition suggests movement and interaction between the figures within this structured setting.

artworks.title: Sacrifice Scene (Gaius Mucius Scaevola?)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of numerous figures in various dynamic poses. The central figure is on a pedestal and others are interacting around them. The figures are detailed, showing muscular outlines and flowing garments. A draped fabric above adds depth to the scene. Faint landscape details are visible in the background.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 25.4 x 19.4 cm (10 x 7 5/8 in.)
support: 30 x 23.5 cm (11 13/16 x 9 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial gathering with figures in a heavenly setting. The scene depicts an assembly with numerous figures. Some figures are kneeling or gesturing upwards. The upper part of the composition shows seated figures that appear to be observing. The drawing is detailed with flowing robes and dynamic postures, conveying movement and mysticism. The use of light and shade is achieved through delicate line work and subtle washes.

artworks.title: Tribute Money
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing shows nine individuals in a group. The central figure on the right is seated, with his right hand raised, turned slightly towards the other figures. He has wavy hair reaching just past his ears and is wearing loose robes. The other individuals have various facial features and hairstyles, wearing robes with different patterns. Some are standing, leaning inwards, or observing the central action. The seated man appears to be handing or showing an object to the man next to him. The background includes architectural elements like vertical columns or panels. The image is rendered in a warm color palette with detailed figures against a lightly shaded background.

artworks.title: Historical Scene [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black  chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in an outdoor scene. The drawing shows individuals wearing draped garments, interacting with each other. They are set against a backdrop of architectural features and natural elements. In the center, two figures are at the forefront surrounded by others engaged in discussion or observation. The sky is filled with clouds, and there is a prominent tree on the left side. The scene conveys a sense of motion and interaction, with flowing lines of the garments and gestures of the figures adding to the dynamic feel of the piece.

artworks.title: Two Draped Female Figures; Rest on the Flight into Egypt [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black  chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a classical drawing divided into two sections. On the left side, there are two full-body figures shown in standing positions. Both are draped in flowing garments with hoods covering their heads. They have serene facial expressions and appear to be in motion. On the right side, there are three figures seated on a bench or low wall indoors. An elderly man with a beard rests his head on his hand, while an angel with wings leans over him, gesturing outward. A woman holding a child is also present. The background shows an arched window portraying a landscape with trees and clouds, providing depth and an outdoor ambiance. The focus is on the figures themselves, with no visible jewelry or accessories.

artworks.title: Figure of a Man
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure in a dynamic pose with one leg bent and the other extended behind him. He has a muscular physique, with curly hair, and is wearing a short tunic. The background is plain with a textured, slightly stained paper surface.

artworks.title: The Meeting of San Carlo Borromeo and San Filippo Neri
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering of figures. The artwork shows a group of figures positioned in a scene that could be seen as a discussion or meeting. The figures are wearing long robes, some holding staffs topped with small crosses. Architectural elements such as grand buildings with columns and decorative facades are present. The landscape in the background features rolling hills. The drawing uses brown ink washes and linework to create depth and shadow and is signed by the artist in the corner.

artworks.title: Sacrifice of Abraham
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over black chalk on darkened paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil and ink drawing showing a scene with various figures at different distances. There is a stone structure in the center towards the upper right, with a group engaged in interaction. Close to us, there are figures, one carrying sticks and others walking casually. Further along the path, there are more figures, adding a sense of motion and narrative. In the distance, a house with people and animals is partially hidden by trees. The drawing features loose brushstrokes in earthy tones and shades of brown, creating a classic, antique feel.

artworks.title: Battle Scene
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 20.2 x 20.3 cm (7 15/16 x 8 in.)
support: 37.4 x 37.9 cm (14 3/4 x 14 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in physical struggle or dynamic movement. The scene is characterized by tumultuous lines and intertwined limbs of the figures. Shading and cross-hatching techniques are used to give depth to the anatomical features, emphasizing muscles and movement. The composition suggests chaos and action, creating a sense of tension and urgency. There is a minimal background, focusing the viewer's attention on the interaction and forms of the figures. The figures are strong and depicted in various animated poses.

artworks.title: Virtue Triumphing over Vices
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 11.6 x 15.7 cm (4 9/16 x 6 3/16 in.)
support: 18.7 x 25.2 cm (7 3/8 x 9 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts five individuals in a classical drawing style. At the center is a standing person wearing a long garment, a crown, holding a staff in one hand and a bundle of reeds in the other. Flanking the central figure, there are two seated individuals on each side. On the left, one figure is hooded, while another holds a jug with curly hair. On the right, there are figures holding a mirror and gesturing dramatically. The figures wear draped attire with floral or feathered accessories, surrounded by floral motifs and ornamental designs. The drawing is set on a textured paper background.

artworks.title: Philomela, Procne, and the Thracian King Tereus
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures. Two figures on the left are interacting with a commanding figure on the right who is seated on a throne-like structure. The drawing uses expressive lines and shading. The seated figure wears a crown and rich clothing, while the others are gesturing or pleading. The artwork is monochrome with varying tones, emphasizing expression and posture details.

artworks.title: Saint Peter
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 13.1 x 5.8 cm (5 3/16 x 2 5/16 in.)
support: 21.6 x 14.3 cm (8 1/2 x 5 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a bearded man in a dynamic posture, standing with a slight lean to his left. He has a curly hairstyle framing his facial features, including a prominent brow and slightly furrowed brows. He is dressed in classical attire with a draped cloak, and holds a large key in his right hand and a book in his left hand. The background is a plain texture and the sketch is framed with a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Nude Male Figure [recto]
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure seated on a surface, facing away from the viewer. The person is in a dynamic seated position, with one arm bent upwards and the other resting behind on the surface. The figure has long hair tied up, detailed musculature, and is unclothed. A drapery is visible under the figure. The background is plain, drawn in red chalk on beige paper. There are no visible jewelry or objects.

artworks.title: Nude Female Figure [verso]
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white chalk
artworks.description: The image is a pencil and chalk drawing of a seated nude figure in a side profile. The individual is seated on a draped fabric or cushion, with one knee bent. The figure's head is turned away from the viewer, appearing to hold or adjust a piece of fabric or towel on their head. The person's long hair flows down the back. The detailed drawing captures the curves and lines of the human form. The backdrop is simple, with textured lines suggesting drapery or movement for added depth.

artworks.title: Nude Figure (academic study)
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening on blue paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a person seen from the back. The person is seated, with a slightly twisted torso, a bent right leg, and their left arm extended upward, holding onto ropes or cords. The person has long, flowing hair with loose strands. They are unclothed, with no visible jewelry or objects, set against a background of crosshatched lines.

artworks.title: Saint Barbara in Glory with Saints Nicholas and Jerome
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash heightened with white on handmade rag paper
artworks.description: The image features three human figures and several cherubs in a classical artwork style. The upper portion shows a person depicted from the waist up, positioned within the clouds, their head slightly tilted upward, and one arm slightly raised while holding a palm frond. This person's facial features are delicate, with curly hair and a calm expression, adorned with a flowing robe. Accompanying this figure are several winged cherubs, one of whom appears to be holding a tower-like structure. The lower half of the image presents two additional standing figures on either side of a large, wheel-like symbol. Both are dressed in long, flowing garments, and one figure holds a crook-like staff. Their faces are less detailed, adding a sense of abstraction to their forms. The background displays a lively sky filled with swirling clouds, creating a dramatic and ethereal setting. The entire scene is composed with a sepia-toned palette, giving it an aged and classical appearance.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome (?)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and peach wash squared with black chalk
artworks.description: The image features several human figures depicted in a sketch-like style with light red and brown tones. In the foreground, an older seated man with a long beard leans on his right hand, looking upward towards another figure. Beside him sits a lion with its mouth slightly open. A winged figure stands to the left offering a crown to the seated man. In the upper section, a divine figure seated upon clouds extends their arms outward. This figure is surrounded by four other smaller figures sitting on clouds, engaged with each other. The background suggests an ethereal, cloudy environment.

artworks.title: The Deluge, from the Loggia of the Vatican
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene featuring mythological figures and animals. The drawing depicts a collection of nude figures interacting in a landscape setting. In the central foreground, two muscular figures seem engaged in a dynamic posture. Surrounding these figures, there are more characters in various poses. On the left, a figure appears crouched down beside a large animal, possibly a horse, and is looking toward the central figures. The background features undulating lines suggesting hills or clouds, and a few structures resembling ancient architecture. The scene is rendered in delicate lines, providing a sense of movement and flow across the composition.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman Taken in Adultery
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash on laidpaper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with figures. The scene shows a group of individuals within a grand classical architectural setting characterized by tall columns and a large, ornate doorway. The figures are dressed in traditional, flowing robes. The background architecture includes intricate details like pilasters and a circular window above the door. The floor is a checkered pattern. The drawing uses sepia tones and a composition style reminiscent of European Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Two Nudes
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a study of two male figures showing their back and waist up, focusing on the muscular anatomy. Both figures have broad shoulders and defined muscular backs, with detailed attention given to the curvature and tension of the muscles. They are in seated positions, slightly turned to the side. The drawing does not show their heads in full detail, but some facial features such as the outline of the jaw and part of the ear can be seen. The hair is suggested by flowing lines. The sketch is rendered in a reddish-brown medium on a textured, light background, possibly paper. The background is plain, and there are visible stains and marks on the paper.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure and animals in a woodland. The figure is in a composed pose surrounded by foliage and bark textures. The animals are near the figure in a peaceful setting. A hut is included in the scene, along with trees, light and shadow, and distant mountains. The drawing is done in ink.

artworks.title: Nine Figures
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash heightened with white on green prepared paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of intertwined figures. The work depicts a chaotic tangle of human forms, showing muscular figures in various poses—some reaching upward with outstretched arms, others appearing to engage in an emotional struggle. The use of dark shading and highlights on the bodies create a sense of depth and movement, emphasizing the tension within the scene. Colored in pale green with touches of white, the background shows architectural elements, including arches.
